fusions.name: Miles of Hunger
fusions.desc: A thrown strike that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Stamping Wake
fusions.desc: A stamping turn that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Ceaseless Stride
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds, and your movement speed by 15% for the first 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Road-Fed
fusions.desc: Each time you cover enough ground, your damage heals you for 12% of what it deals for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
